name: Soportújar (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and black, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Soportújar (a bridge, a tree and a witch).
history: Soportújar adopted its arms and flag officially on 14 October 2014; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three equal vertical stripes, red at the hoist, white in the centre and black at the fly, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Soportújar arms — bridge, tree and witch
